title: 6 Southeast Asia reps unable to compete in Miss Universe 2026 amid franchise dispute
summary: Six representatives from Southeast Asia will not be flying to Puerto Rico for the 75th Miss Universe competition as a result of an ongoing dispute among pageant executives.
